event.title: Notting Hill Carnival Celebrates 60 Years of Afro-Caribbean Culture
event.canonical_title: Notting Hill Carnival Celebrates 60 Years of Afro-Caribbean Culture
event.summary: The Notting Hill Carnival has returned to West London, celebrating its 60th anniversary with vibrant displays of British Afro-Caribbean culture. The three-day event features music, dancing, and colorful costumes, attracting millions of visitors to the streets of London.
